item.title: Anker's S2000 is the smallest 2kWh home backup power station around — and it just dropped to $650 in Amazon's Labor Day sale
item.description: This 2,010Wh home backup unit delivers 1500W continuous output, 3000W peak, 10,000-cycle battery rating, and up to 35-hour fridge backup.

item.title: The Tetris Company wants nothing to do with the White House's new copycat game
item.description: Tetris knockoff 'Build the Wall' is one of six new games hosted on the White House website, and The Tetris Company is not happy.

item.title: AI compute provider Nscale is looking for $3.5B in pre-IPO financing
item.description: Nscale, which recently struck a $45 billion deal with Anthropic, is in talks to raise additional funds in anticipation of an upcoming IPO.

item.title: Tesla’s viral ad for its new Cybercab robotaxi has one glaring problem
item.description: ‘You can just tell not a single disabled person was consulted for this,’ reads one critique on social media. The newest addition to Tesla’s fleet of robotaxis is now on the road. Previously, Tesla’s driverless taxi service offered only one make of vehicle, called the Model Y. Now, it’s adding the Cybercab, a golden car with butterfly doors, interactive touchscreens, and no steering wheel....
